Open any transaction to choose a category. Suggested chips may appear based on the merchant or what you picked before. You can add custom categories from the add flow. When you save, you can optionally apply the same category to other transactions from that merchant.

In transaction details, add tags to group spending by trip, person, project, or anything you track. Tags are for your own organization and do not change budget totals. Use search on the transactions screen to find merchants, notes, and tags.
